s: Taam lamma omerim mishnat "ezehu meqoman" ubo g' seipim: qabeu lishnot achar parashat hattamid pereq "ezehu meqoman" uberayta derabbi yishmael, kede sheyyizkeh kol adam lilmod bekol yom miqra mishna vetalmud, dibrayta derabbi yishmael hi bimqom talmud shehammidrash ketalmud. Umippene shehi techillat torat kohanim, shehu rosh lekol parashat haqqorbanot — qebauha etzel haqqorbanot. Veken mishnat "ezehu meqoman" qebauha achar hattamid, mishshum shenneemar: "ubekol maqom muqtar muggash lishmi", veki bekol maqom maqtirin umaggishin? Ella ellu talmide chakamim sheoseqin behilkot aboda bekol yom bekol maqom shehem — maaleh ani alehem keillu maqtirim umaggishim lishmi. Veod, mippene shebbepereq zeh en bo machaloqet vehu mishna berura lemosheh missinay:

En qeriat pereq zeh uberayta zo ola lelimmud mishna vetalmud ella lemi shemmebin, abal mi sheeno mebin — tzarik lilmod ulehabin, sheim lo ken eno nechshab lelimmud, sheap bitpilla mutab lehitpallel belashon shemmebin, ella sheyyesh lomar sheap shehu eno mebin haqqadosh baruk hu yodea kavvanato umebin, abal im omer hammishna veeno mebin — eno niqra limmud kelal:

Yesh meqomot sheen omerim "ezehu meqoman" bebet haabel, mippene sheasur betalmud tora. Veen zeh nakon, shekkol shehu seder hayyom — en bo mishshum talmud tora laabel, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqn"d ubeyoreh dea siman shp"d:
